title: Wafaqi Mohtasib Investigation and Disposal of Complaints Regulations 2003

sections.shortTitle: Wafaqi Mohtasib Investigation and Disposal of Complaints Regulations 2003
sections.section: RULE - Wafaqi Mohtasib (Investigation and Disposal of Complaints) Regulations 2003
sections.description:
WAFAQI MOHTASIB (INVESTIGATION AND
WAFAQI MOHTASIB
(INVESTIGATION AND
DISPOSAL OF
COMPLAINTS) REGULATIONS, 2003
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
1st September, 2007]
S.R.O.52(KE)/2007, dated 17-8-2007.--In
exercise of the powers conferred upon him by Clause (11) of Article 10 of the
Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983, the
Wafaqi Mohtasib is pleased to make the following amendments in Wafaqi Mohtasib
(Investigation and Disposal of Complaints) Regulations, 2003.
Regulation 2-Definitions.--For
Clause 2(1) below
Sub-Clause (n) a new Sub-Clasue (o) shall be inserted.
(o) "Principal Officer" means
an Officer authorised by the Agency to receive the notice for submission of
reports.
Regulation 3-Presentations of Complaints.--In Clause (1), in fourth
line after the words "Courier Service", the words "fax, email or
any other means of communication', shall be inserted.
Regulation
5-Admission and rejection of complaints at preliminary stage.--In Clause
(3), in third line after words "and pass it on" the words
"within twenty four hours" shall be inserted.
Regulation
7-Presentation of complaints to Mohtasib and personal hearing.--In Clauses
(2) and (3), the expression 'Director General (Complaints)" and Director
General (Complaints)/Consultant (Complaints) shall be substituted with the
expression "Registrar".
Regulation
9-Preliminary processing of complaints not to be delayed.--In Clause (2),
the existing expression "Director General (Complaints)" shall be
substituted with the expression "Authorized Officer at Head Office."
Regulation
11-Report from Agency.--In clause (1), in third line after "in
writing" the following new sentence shall be inserted:
"within a
maximum of two days of receipt of the complaint by the Investigating
Officer."
For existing
Clause (4), the following shall be substituted :
(4) "The
report shall be required to be submitted within fifteen days."
In Clause (5)
in 2nd line the figure "thirty" shall be substituted with figure
"fifteen."
Regulation
12-List of principal officers of the Agencies and their nominees.--In
Clauses (1) and (3) the existing expression "Director General
Complains" shall be substituted with expression "Authorized
Officer."
Regulation
13-Agency's report on allegation of the Complainant.--The existing Clauses
(3) and (4) shall be substituted with following Clauses and a new Clause (5)
shall also be inserted:--
"(3)
Where the Agency does not submit the report within the time specified in the
notice issued under clause (4) of regulation 11 or the extended time allowed on
the request of the Agency under clause (5) of the same regulation, the
Investigating Officer shall within two days after the due date, issue a notice
to the Agency requiring it to depute an officer fully conversant with the facts
of the case to appear before him within
fifteen days on
the date and
time specified in
the said notice along with complete
record of the
case and produce
all such documents
(including law, rules,
regulations or instructions)
which he intends to rely upon for meeting the allegations made in the
com plaint.
(4) A copy of
the notice, referred to in sub-regulation (3), shall also be sent to the complainant
requiring him to appear before the Investigating Officer on the date and time
specified in the said notice and to produce all such documents which he intends
to rely upon in support of his allegations made in the complaint.
(5) Where the
officer, referred to in sub-regulation (3), does not appear before the
Investigating Officer on the appointed date, proceedings for exercise of the
powers of a Civil Court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (Act V of 1908)
as specified in clause (1) of Article 14 of Establishment of the Office of
Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983 (P.O. No.1 of 1983) to compel
appearance and production of documents may be initiated."
Regulation
14-Rejoinder and hearing of cases.--The existing Regulation shall be substituted
